versions.changelog: Incident-level dedup: prevents channel spam. Multiple reports about the same event (e.g., 7 DXB airport updates) now collapse into 1 alert.
CRITICAL FIX: World Monitor dedup bug — new events silently filtered. Keyword word-order bug — DXB airport attacks missed. Both fixed.
v3.2: Optional LLM verification (ollama/openai/none), improved CRITICAL validation with negative patterns, corroboration-aware cooldowns
v3.0.3: Security hardening — TLS verification enforced (no --insecure); removed ssl_verify=false sources; sanitize/truncate untrusted source text before embedding into LLM prompts
v3.0.2: channel publisher can load AEGIS_BOT_TOKEN/AEGIS_CHANNEL_ID from ~/.openclaw/.env; enables CRITICAL daytime posting without hardcoded secrets
v3.0.1: AEGIS-scan posts CRITICAL alerts to channel using CRITICAL ALERT format + pins
Release v3.0.0: CRITICAL-only daytime, briefing pipeline, live-feed toggle
Fix ClawHub metadata: declared binaries (curl, python3), optional env vars, homepage/source URLs, documented all outbound connections. No telemetry.

CRITICAL threshold tightened: only immediate physical danger in-country triggers instant alerts. Regional threats (Hormuz, neighbor attacks) are HIGH. Updated README with 23+ sources, alert classification docs.
World Monitor integration (168 geolocated conflict zones). OPSEC hardening — zero personal info in channel output.
LiveUAMap integration — near-instant conflict events from Iran, Ukraine, Israel. 22 sources, 161 items/scan.
Anti-spam architecture: silent 15-min scans (only CRITICAL alerts post), formatted morning/evening briefings, channel publisher script
Initial release — 19 verified sources, UAE country profile, 3-tier alerts, emergency preparedness guides, interactive onboarding, morning/evening briefings. Zero API keys required.
